description: This file defines types, interfaces, and function signatures for the application's state management related to notes and folders, outlining the shape of context data and available actions in the store.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note with optional initial data.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by its ID with provided data.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes the note specified by its ID.

methods.name: togglePin
methods.description: Toggles the pinned state of a note identified by its ID.

methods.name: createFolder
methods.description: Creates a new folder with a given name and optional color.

methods.name: updateFolder
methods.description: Updates an existing folder identified by its ID with provided data.

methods.name: deleteFolder
methods.description: Deletes the folder specified by its ID.

methods.name: setSelectedFolderId
methods.description: Sets the currently selected folder by ID or null.

methods.name: setSortMode
methods.description: Sets the current sort mode for notes.
